question: 5 boys P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). Q and R are immediate neighbours. S and R are immediate neighbours. Only P is to the left of Q. Who is sitting in the middle of the row?
solution:
Given: Five boys P, Q, R, S and T are sitting in a row facing north.

Q and R are immediate neighbours.

S and R are immediate neighbours.

Only P is to the left of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3318b88792c9ed609cf42ad8c3f4897c86dba89b9e8ccf6cabae54f0591888ab.png] 

Middle position (3rd) = R

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
